metadata.title: FOOD CRAWL at the MOUNTAIN TOP I LADAKH Food Tour
metadata.description:
Watch the final video of Jammu and Kashmir food series where we take you on a food crawl at the mountain top covering  Sonmarg, Kargil, Gurudwara Pathar Sahib and Leh. 

The trip was thoroughly rewarding and we had a great time exploring the local cuisine. The scenic beauty was incredible, despite the harsh weather conditions we thoroughly enjoyed
this journey and would definitely go back for the warm people and the food! It was not the easiest of journeys but it is definitely a journey that will remain close to our heart forever.

About the host- Anubhav Sapra :

Anubhav Sapra is an avid foodie! He is a Founder but proudly calls himself a Foodie-in-chief at Delhi Food Walks. He is also a street-food and Indian regional cuisine connoisseur and loves to write about street-food.

Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! Thank you for watching!
